teaching_sources.title: Fluent 2 Layout
supported_principles: Spacing can group content without extra graphical dividers
teaching_sources.project_application: Use a consistent spacing ramp and fewer independent panel backgrounds.

teaching_sources.title: The details of UI typography, WWDC20
teaching_sources.content_access: official video page and transcript read
supported_principles: Text styles combine weight, size, and leading
Size alone may not sufficiently distinguish subtle hierarchy
Long text can benefit from increased leading
teaching_sources.project_application: Define fixed title, item-name, body, and secondary text roles; reserve decorative typography for large titles.

teaching_sources.title: Motion
supported_principles: Shared axis represents spatial or navigational relationships
Parent-child navigation may use the z axis
Forward and backward transitions need coordinated configuration
Fade through suits destinations without a strong relationship
Documented default shared-axis duration is 300ms and standard easing is cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)
teaching_sources.project_application: Use paired transitions for home/detail navigation and fade-through for unrelated full pages; do not treat decorative idle motion as navigation feedback.
